notes: ARC1-007 is the active ticket: mount the Three.js laboratory through RuntimeHost without touching /jugar. /arc-plan narrows this contract to the exact artifacts when it writes the ficha, exactly as versions 5, 7 and 9 did for ARC1-004, ARC1-005 and ARC1-006.

ARC1-007 is the first ticket of this run that changes runtime, not only the control plane. Its plan must open the src/** paths it needs one by one; src/** stays globally protected until then, and src/jugar/** stays prohibited outright under H3_CONTRACT.md section 3.
ARC1-006 closed DONE with two packets. ARC1-006-A measured; ARC1-006-B froze SCENE_BUDGETS.md. Both move from director/write to protected, consistent with CP-020.

Frozen canon is now eight documents: GOLDEN_FRAMES.md, IDENTITY.md and LEGAL_REFERENCES.md from ARC1-003 (CP-015); COLOR_SCRIPT.md and SHOT_DECK.md from ARC1-004 (CP-018); SCENE_INVENTORY.md and CONTENT_V2.md from ARC1-005 (CP-019); SCENE_BUDGETS.md from ARC1-006 (CP-020). Protected means no ticket may edit them to make its own result pass; amending requires its own CP decision, not a ticket.

Precedence on conflict: GOLDEN_FRAMES.md beats SHOT_DECK.md; the earlier frozen document beats the later one. SCENE_BUDGETS.md may report that an already frozen requirement does not fit under the H3 ceiling, but may not lower the requirement or raise the ceiling.

vite.config.ts is now explicitly protected. ARC1-006 found that the slice harness is not one of its build inputs; the temptation to add it, or to tune the config so a measurement comes out better, belongs to no ticket of this run without its own CP decision.
SCENE_BUDGETS.md gives ARC1-008 a number it did not have: the leak gate is 512 kB per mount-to-destroy cycle. ARC1-008 measures it for the first time; it does not get to change it.

Every scene ticket from ARC1-011 onward closes with a renderer.info sweep over its own anchors, in 1440x900 and 390x844, with the protocol of evidence/ARC1-006/runtime-budget.json. A scene ticket without that measurement does not close.
No ticket may declare fps before ARC1-060 (CP-014). The 0.264 ms in runtime-budget.json is forced-frame CPU cost, not frame time: it excludes GPU wait and presentation, and rAF was throttled.

SHOT_DECK.md section 2 makes the safe areas binding. The mobile HUD currently fails it by a measured margin (evidence/ARC1-004/hud-rects.json). Fixing it belongs to ARC1-026. Do not correct it opportunistically.

OI-002 and OI-003 stay open, both P2, both about scene E2. OI-004 and OI-005 are new, both P2: manifest bytes recorded in LF against a CRLF tree, and sprite atlases inlined as data URIs into the critical startup bundle. Destinations ARC1-035 and ARC1-028. Converting an OI into a ticket is the Director's call, never the executor's (CP-002).
H3_CONTRACT.md is authorized and frozen; amending it requires a new CP decision.
builder and reviewer get append-only access to OPEN_ISSUES.md and telemetry.json (CP-017). Append-only means adding a row or a record; never editing or deleting existing ones.

Rotating this contract is step E of EXECUTION_PROTOCOL.md, executed at close. Version 10 was written as part of closing ARC1-006, not when opening ARC1-007: that is the fix CP-017 introduced after OI-001.
